field_mapping.extension_field_rationale: The task said to match the Job schema exactly (field names/id format/ordering) for the mapped fields, but rows_v1.jsonl carries real scholarly content (device_notes, observed_substrate_signals) and pipeline provenance (writer_part/writer_decision_id/writer_attempt_id) with no Job-schema slot. Dropping them would silently discard evidence and provenance, which conflicts with the standing preservation policy. They are appended AFTER the 12 Job-mapped fields, in a fixed order, so the first 12 keys of every chunks.jsonl line are Job-schema-identical and any consumer expecting exactly the Job shape can safely ignore or strip the tail.

literature_type_guess_caveat: Job's literature_type_guess is free-text prose-genre description (e.g. 'prose frame: Job's character portrait and wealth catalog'). Ps's unit_type is a five-value structural enum (whole_psalm 34, strophe 410, refrain_unit 22, letter_stanza 22, coda 4) reflecting Hebrew poetic macro-structure, not narrative genre. These fields serve an analogous PURPOSE (categorize the chunk's literary unit) but are not the same kind of data. Mapped 1:1 as the closest existing analog per task instruction; not rewritten into invented prose-genre descriptions.
